about: A correction of a command; "it" is only clear from the assistant turn.

messages.content: How do I run the chat-ui unit tests?
Open Git Bash and run: cd /e/redstart-project/redstart-nest/src/chat-ui && npx vitest run
No, don't do it that way. Run it from E:\ in PowerShell. The /e/ path makes vitest load twice and every test fails.

right.text: Run chat-ui vitest from E:\ in PowerShell, never from the /e/ Git Bash path
